summaries.text:
Veteran Wildland Firefighter Employment Act of 2025

This bill requires the Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Agriculture, and Department of the Interior to jointly establish a two-year pilot program to employ veterans in wildland firefighting activities.

title: Veteran Wildland Firefighter Employment Act of 2025
